summary: Silence Therapeutics plc filed an 8-K to report entry into an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC, replacing a prior 2021 agreement. The company may offer and sell ADSs (each representing three ordinary shares) in at-the-market offerings up to a maximum program amount, with Jefferies receiving up to 3.0% commission. The filing is a routine at-the-market issuance facility, not a transformative special situation. No specific deal terms, premiums, or change of control are involved. No board recommendation or advisor role is noted beyond Jefferies as sales agent. Watch for market-price-dependent issuance updates, but no arbitrage angle exists.
